summary: Clene Inc. filed an 8-K reporting that its subsidiary Clene Nanomedicine entered on October 15, 2026 into a fourth-year subaward amendment with NYU as prime awardee under the NIH Grant supporting an Expanded Access Program for CNM-Au8 in ALS. The amendment provides up to $7.2 million for September 1, 2026 through August 31, 2027, consistent with prior annual tranches. Other subaward terms remain unchanged. This is a routine grant-funding contract, not a special situation; no ownership, pricing, board recommendation, or regulatory clock is implicated. Watch for grant continuity and funding cadence.
